headline: Chilli Beans files for extrajudicial recovery to renegotiate R$ 340 million debt
summary: Chilli Beans has requested extrajudicial recovery to renegotiate R$ 340 million in debt through an agreement featuring an injection led by its creditors.
why: Corporate debt restructuring processes are critical events for evaluating the financial health and going-concern status of retail brands.

impacts.name: Chilli Beans
impacts.why: Financial distress and debt restructuring filings signal credit risk for the enterprise.
